subject: NovumCloud: Portal onboarding & minimum evidence path
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@novumcloud.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: security@novumcloud.com
Date: Sat, 14 Apr 2028 15:22:00 -0400
Subject: NovumCloud: Portal onboarding & minimum evidence path

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this — we’re kicking off our vendor intake for Redwood and want to avoid a big evidence dump if possible. We have profiles in Vendr and OneTrust; our compliance team is asking for a clear ‘minimum acceptable proof’ list for SIG / CAIQ rows that are required to close pre-deal security review.

High level:
- We need SOC 2 scope notes and a few sample artifacts (system config export, access log snippet).
- The buying team wants to keep onboarding within 5 business days if feasible.

Can you share a checklist and preferred upload method (pre-signed S3, direct portal upload, or vendor portal API)? I’ve attached a short SIG fragment that the buyer sent with the most urgent rows highlighted.

Appreciate any quick guidance and whether Redwood will accept a compact evidence bundle (signed CAIQ subset + one month of masked access logs).

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Security Programs
NovumCloud

Attachments: SIG-fragment.xlsx (spreadsheet stub, 34KB)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena@novumcloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 14 Apr 2028 17:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: NovumCloud: Portal onboarding & minimum evidence path

Elena,

Appreciate the SIG fragment — we can definitely keep this light. Quick answers up front:

1) Minimum evidence set (what we accept to mark a row as satisfied):
   - SOC 2: system overview + SOC 2 type 2 report (PDF) OR an attestation letter if report is delayed
   - SIG/CAIQ critical rows: policy doc + single configuration screenshot or exported policy snippet
   - Access logs: 7–30 days masked sample in .txt (IP redacted) — one day of logs is fine for initial review

2) Preferred upload flow:
   - Vendr profile upload is preferred (we auto-ingest CAIQ/SIG rows). If you can’t, presigned S3 upload to our intake bucket works; we’ll provide a one-time presign link.

3) Mapping approach:
   - We’ll map your SIG fragment to our internal acceptance criteria. If a row is borderline, we’ll ask for a single targeted artifact rather than a full bundle.

I’ve attached a short one-page quicklist and the presign instructions template — use whichever is easiest. If you’re able to complete the Vendr profile and drop the SIG fragment there, that’s the fastest path and keeps everything in sync with the buyer.

Proposed next steps:
- You drop the SIG fragment into Vendr (or reply and we’ll send a presign link)
- We review and reply with any targeted asks within 24 hours
- If needed, schedule a 30-minute evidence walk-through with Marissa (CS/Onboarding)

I’m looping in Marissa and Karthik for intake and any SSO/API details.

—
Jonas Weber
Security Intake Lead
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_quicklist.pdf (PDF stub, 12KB); presign_template.txt (instructions)
From: NovumCloud Security Team <security@novumcloud.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena@novumcloud.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 15 Apr 2028 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Re: NovumCloud: Portal onboarding & minimum evidence path

Thanks Jonas — good plan. A few clarifying points from our intake: we can do Vendr but need API keys for automated uploads (our procurement flow will push once we have a confirmed endpoint). If Vendr is not possible within the week, please send the presigned S3 link and we’ll upload the compact bundle.

Specific asks from the buyer (copied below from their SIG highlights):
- SIG row SIG-A11 (encryption at rest): provide encryption algorithm + KMS configuration snippet
- SIG row SIG-A25 (separation of duties): provide the RBAC role mapping export or a screenshot of role matrix

I’ve attached a trimmed access-log sample and the highlighted SIG workbook we exported.

—
Elena (on behalf of NovumCloud Sec Team)

Attachments: access-log-sample.txt (log stub, 48KB); SIG-fragment.xlsx (updated)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: NovumCloud Security Team <security@novumcloud.com>, Elena Rossi <elena@novumcloud.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 15 Apr 2028 10:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: NovumCloud: Portal onboarding & minimum evidence path

Elena / NovumCloud team — thanks, we can handle both options. Quick confirmation:

- I will send a Vendr profile invite to security@novumcloud.com within 90 minutes so you can attempt a direct upload. The API key route is supported; if you want that we can exchange a short-term key (scope: profile:write, ttl: 48h).
- If Vendr upload fails, reply to this thread and I’ll post a presigned S3 link (one-time, 72h expiry) and a short checklist for the evidence filenames we expect.
- For the two SIG rows Elena called out: attach a single .txt snippet showing KMS key ARN + algorithm for A11, and an exported CSV of role mappings for A25 (or two screenshots). That will let us mark those rows satisfied for the initial review.

I’ve scheduled a 30-minute intake slot for Tuesday 2028-04-17 09:30 PT (calendar invite sent separately) — please accept if you’d like us to walk through the bundle together.

Marissa Cole
Customer Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
